page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7t.3xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 12 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 6 physical Intel Xeon 8369B processor cores running at 2.7 GHz. The system is equipped with 48.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. It utilizes the x86_64 architecture and includes an L3 cache of 48 MB. Local storage is not bundled with this instance, and it does not include any GPU accelerators. Network connectivity is supported by an 8 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Benchmark results place this instance consistently in the average tier across multiple workloads. The Intel Xeon processor delivers a Geekbench single-core score of 1600.0 and a multi-core score of 7934.0. In stress-ng testing, single-core CPU performance reached 1881.48, while multi-core performance registered at 11646.62. Memory performance is characterized by a read-only small block cached bandwidth of 635.14 GB/sec, which drops to 78.98 GB/sec for uncached large blocks. Cryptographic and integer operations are accelerated by hardware flags such as AES, VAES, SHA_NI, and AVX-512.

Given its balanced resource allocation and dedicated CPU execution, the ecs.g7t.3xlarge is suited for general-purpose workloads such as static web serving, software compilation, and database operations. It achieved a static web serving throughput of 17.22 GB/sec and 12.02 million operations per second in Redis SET benchmarks. While it handles small-scale language model inference adequately, processing 1080.28 tokens per second for a 135M model, performance drops significantly for larger models, with 7B model prompt processing falling into the weak category at 24.27 tokens per second. The lack of local storage requires external block storage attachment.
